title: User login with valid credentials
description: Validate that a user can successfully login using valid email and password credentials and receive a JWT token with 24-hour validity.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter a valid email and password
Click the login button
Verify login is successful and JWT token is received with 24-hour validity
Verify user is redirected to the dashboard with role-based menu items

title: User login with invalid credentials
description: Verify that the system correctly handles login with invalid email or password by denying access and showing an error message.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Enter invalid email or password
Click the login button
Verify login is denied and an appropriate error message is displayed
Verify no JWT token is issued

title: Access control enforcement for Admin features
description: Ensure that only users with the Admin role can access and perform user management operations such as create, edit, delete users and assign roles.

steps.description: Login as a non-Admin user
Attempt to access the User Management page or API endpoints
Verify access is denied and unauthorized error is returned
Login as Admin user
Access User Management page and create, edit, delete users
Verify operations succeed and data is stored correctly

title: Create new user with valid email and strong password
description: Verify that Admin can create a new user with valid email format and password meeting security rules.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to User Management page
Enter valid user email, assign role, and enter strong password
Submit the user creation form
Verify new user is created and visible in the user list
Verify password is stored securely (hashed)

title: User management validation - invalid email or weak password
description: Verify the system prevents creating or updating users with invalid email formats or passwords that do not meet complexity requirements.

steps.description: Login as Admin
Navigate to User Management page
Attempt to create or update a user with invalid email format
Verify appropriate validation error message is displayed and creation/updation is blocked
Attempt to create or update a user with a weak password
Verify password complexity error message is shown and operation is blocked

title: Article creation with valid data including barcode generation
description: Validate that an authorized user can create articles/products with all required fields including price in cents and barcode generation linked to article SKU.

steps.description: Login with Order Coordinator or Admin role
Navigate to Article Management page
Fill in article creation form with valid SKU, name, description, pricing in cents
Submit the form
Verify article is created and visible in the listing
Verify barcode is generated, matches the SKU, and can be scanned

title: Article creation with missing or invalid data
description: Ensure the system enforces validation for mandatory fields and proper data formatting during article creation.

steps.description: Login with Order Coordinator or Admin role
Navigate to Article Management page
Submit article creation form with missing SKU or invalid price format
Verify system displays validation errors and blocks creation

title: Inventory stock update on goods receipt
description: Verify that when Goods Receipt is registered by Warehouse Employee, the inventory stock levels are updated correctly and stock movement history is recorded.

steps.description: Login as Warehouse Employee
Navigate to Goods Receipt page
Create a new goods receipt with multiple articles and quantities
Submit the goods receipt
Verify inventory stock levels are increased accordingly for each article
Verify stock movement history reflects the goods receipt transaction

title: Low stock alert triggering
description: Validate that the system triggers low stock alerts correctly when article inventory falls below predefined thresholds after deliveries or stock movements.

steps.description: Set low stock threshold for an article
Process deliveries or stock movements to reduce inventory below threshold
Verify the low stock warning alert appears in inventory page and notifications

title: Order creation with sufficient stock validation
description: Test that an Order Coordinator can create orders with multiple articles and the system validates stock availability and calculates total price and quantity correctly.

steps.description: Login as Order Coordinator
Navigate to Order Creation page
Add multiple articles with quantities that are within current stock levels
Assign external order number and submit order
Verify order is created successfully with correct total price and quantity
Verify order status is set properly and history is tracked

title: Order creation with insufficient stock handling
description: Verify the system prevents order creation when ordered quantities exceed available stock and displays appropriate error messages.

steps.description: Login as Order Coordinator
Navigate to Order Creation page
Add articles with quantities exceeding available inventory
Attempt to submit the order
Verify order creation is blocked and error message about insufficient stock is displayed

title: Order status workflow and delivery processing
description: Verify the full order lifecycle from creation, status updates through processing to delivery confirmation including stock deduction.

steps.description: Create an order as Order Coordinator
Update the order status through all workflow stages (e.g., Confirmed, Processing, Ready for Delivery)
Process outbound delivery and confirm delivery completion
Verify inventory stock is deducted correctly upon delivery
Verify order history tracks all status changes accurately
Verify user interface displays status changes and delivery confirmation clearly

title: Barcode scanning integration for inventory actions
description: Validate that barcode scanning works correctly for inventory stock adjustments and article lookups.

steps.description: Navigate to Inventory management page
Scan the barcode of an article using integrated scanner
Verify article details are displayed correctly based on the scanned barcode
Use barcode scanning to register stock movement or goods receipt
Verify inventory updates correctly according to scanned input

title: Data export functionality test
description: Ensure users can export reports and data correctly in supported formats and the exported data matches the filtered on-screen data.

steps.description: Navigate to Data Export page
Apply filters for report data
Trigger data export to CSV or Excel format
Verify export file downloads successfully
Verify exported file contains correct and complete data matching filters

title: API endpoint performance and error handling under load
description: Test that key API endpoints (authentication, user, order, inventory, and stock movement) respond within 2 seconds under load and handle errors correctly.

steps.description: Simulate concurrent API requests using load testing tools
Verify response times for all API endpoints remain under 2 seconds
Send malformed or invalid requests to API endpoints
Verify proper error responses and status codes are returned

title: Responsive UI verification
description: Verify that the system UI is responsive and accessible on various devices and screen sizes, providing intuitive user interactions and clear feedback.

steps.description: Access the system UI on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
Verify layout adapts correctly with Bootstrap 5 responsive design
Verify all menus and navigation are accessible according to user roles
Verify user feedback and error messages are clear and visible

title: Security requirements verification
description: Ensure HTTPS is enforced, input validation is performed on all forms and API inputs, and security-relevant events (login, failures, critical operations) are logged appropriately.

steps.description: Access the application via HTTP and verify redirection or blocking in favor of HTTPS
Submit invalid or malicious inputs on forms and API endpoints
Verify inputs are sanitized and rejected or handled securely
Perform critical operations such as login, user creation, and order submission
Verify logs record these events with timestamps and user identification

title: Data integrity test during concurrent stock movements
description: Validate that inventory transactions are handled with database transactions to maintain data integrity under concurrent stock movement operations.

steps.description: Simulate concurrent updates to stock levels via multiple stock movement requests
Verify database prevents race conditions and maintains accurate stock levels
Verify stock movement history remains consistent and complete
